measurement: false origin-call rate on euploid chromosomes 0.0790 (n=937) with the second parent's own array vs 1.0000 (n=475) from a population median of 4 donors, same statistic and markers (false_positive_rate.csv; the track memo's 0.0024/n=825 is not reproducible from the saved artifact)
remedy: Load a genotype for at least one parent. This is the single highest-value input in the method.

measurement: all 70 whole-chromosome losses in this series are on such arrays; forced through, 28 score and 27 of 28 call the same parent (27 maternal / 1 paternal) at deviance 1.431-23.640, all 28 above the 1.2 gate, while the primary paper predicts the opposite parent
remedy: Re-amplify and re-array the sample; or load a sibling unit of the same embryo; or load a matched euploid array of the same WGA chemistry and accept a stated loss of self-referencing.

trigger: segment won by a symmetric Beta(a,a) with a near 1.5
measurement: pat:PNzyg2 chr1 beats the best allelic state by 41,135 log-likelihood units; 34.4% of its mass sits in allelically forbidden zones
remedy: None analytic. The DNA is absent at this locus, not aneuploid. Re-biopsy or re-amplify. Do not report a copy number or an origin.

trigger: deviance per marker >1.20 for the winning state, or dLL <20
measurement: gate retains 251/330 known-parent tests at 1.0000 accuracy and catches all 18 errors the ungated likelihood makes
remedy: None. The segment is outside the model's state space. Report unresolved, never as an origin.

trigger: two closest feasible states separated by <2x2.576 window log2R sd
measurement: 89-100% of detected events on TE and blastomere at k<=800; measured window log2R sd 0.17-0.22 against a needed 0.029-0.081
remedy: Report the ORIGIN and withhold the CLASS as separate fields. Lifting it needs a 3-5x reduction in window log2R sd; 4x more markers buys 1.3x.

refusal: implied f above the own-phase inversion point
trigger: implied f >0.5 with phase taken from the sample's own het calls
measurement: blastomere wrong-parent fraction rises to 0.681 at f=0.70 and attenuation goes to -0.001: a large loss removes the het calls that define the phase set
remedy: Switch to an external phase source (second parent, or a replicate/sibling cell). Above this gate the sample cannot phase itself.

refusal: mosaic fraction below the sign-reliability threshold
measurement: wrong-parent rate 0.250 at f=0.10 and 0.158 at f=0.15, falling below 0.05 only at f=0.30 (0.042)
remedy: Load the second parent, or more independent cells of the same embryo. Report the event unassigned; do not report an origin with a caveat.

refusal: CNN-LOH or UPD with no parent
measurement: the only available channel is het depletion, floor f80 0.65-0.90, and 1% of clean windows already read 40% het-depleted from clustered dropout
remedy: Genotype one parent; the allelic floor drops to 0.04-0.47. Detection and assignment are different problems here and only assignment is cheap.

trigger: segment carries <400 informative markers (47.5 Mb median)
measurement: power 0.526 at k=100, 0.110 at k=25 for a complete BPH gain
remedy: None by statistic choice. The gain deviation f/(4+2f) is intrinsically 2.1-3.0x smaller than a CNN-LOH's at the same f.

refusal: SPH claimed as a positive finding
measurement: SPH's bands (1/3 and 1.0) are both populated by a euploid genome; power at 1% FPR vs euploid is 0.134 at k=400
remedy: Report BPH positively (AUC 1.000 from k=400) and SPH only as 'CN3, not BPH'.

refusal: informative set re-derived inside the candidate interval
trigger: phase set defined from the sample's own het calls within the event
measurement: conditioning is confounded with the estimand; freezing the set outside the interval removes the bias (0.84-1.05)
remedy: Define the informative set from PARENTAL genotypes; if the sample's own calls must be used, freeze them outside the candidate interval and never re-derive inside it.

trigger: missing parent inferred from other embryos of the same couple
measurement: sign flips on 29-38% of chromosomes on amplified material and does not converge at 1-5 siblings; raw bias -0.027 against a true displacement of 0.0072 at f=0.20
remedy: Use haploid products of the missing parent instead (>=5 gives a reference indistinguishable from bulk gDNA). Diploid siblings report a mixture of both parents and cannot resolve mother-het markers.

trigger: several cells of one embryo averaged without fitting both models
measurement: fitting shared-event when the truth is cell-specific inflates implied f by a factor tracking k to within 20% (1.9x at k=2, 4.8x at k=5)
remedy: Fit both the shared-event and cell-specific models and report which was used. An f reported without the model is wrong by up to 6x.

trigger: loaded file's chemistry not in the calibration set
measurement: in-sample estimator is right to 1.6x within seen chemistries but errs to 2.3x on an unseen one, and errs OPTIMISTICALLY on amplified material
remedy: Multiply the predicted threshold by 2.3 and state the widened floor. Refuse mosaic-sensitive calling until that chemistry is calibrated.
